gloss: to disappear suddenly and without a trace; to vanish into thin air.
teaser: Let's explore the mysterious disappearance that this idiom describes!
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Let's explore the mysterious disappearance that this idiom describes! [break 1s] The phrase is: 不翼而飞, bù yì ér fēi. [break 1s] 不 (bù) - not [break 0.5s] 翼 (yì) - wings [break 0.5s] 而 (ér) - and [break 0.5s] 飞 (fēi) - to fly [break 1s] So together, 不翼而飞 literally translates to 'not having wings but flying,' and figuratively means to disappear suddenly and without a trace. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] This idiom originates from a tale about a clever thief who managed to steal a valuable item overnight. When the owner awoke, he found that the item had vanished as if it had flown away without wings. This phrase captures the essence of something that disappears unexpectedly, leaving no evidence behind. [break 1.5s] Example 1: 他的手机不翼而飞了。 [break 1s] His phone vanished into thin air. [break 1s] Example 2: 这些文件在一夜之间不翼而飞。 [break 1s] These documents disappeared overnight. [break 1s] Example 3: 这只鸟不翼而飞，让大家很惊讶。 [break 1s] The bird flew away mysteriously, surprising everyone. [break 1s] So that's 不翼而飞, which means to disappear suddenly and without a trace. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
